# Advisories the Security Gate is allowed to skip.
#
# One GHSA id per line. Everything else at high or critical severity still
# fails the build -- this is a narrow, reviewed exception list, not a way to
# turn the gate off.
#
# An entry may only be added if SECURITY.md carries a written analysis of why
# the advisory does not apply to this codebase, and what would change that
# decision. Remove the entry the moment an upgrade path exists.

# react-router RSC Mode CSRF bypass. Affects react-router >=7.12.0 <8.3.0; we
# run 7.18.2. The vulnerable path requires RSC mode, which a Vite SPA using
# <BrowserRouter> with no server runtime and no router actions does not have.
# Fixed in 8.3.0, which requires React >= 19.2.7 -- a separate upgrade.
# See SECURITY.md, "Accepted dependency advisories".
GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2
